items: 【24000mAh Super Large Battery】FRIZCOL Portable Rechargeable Fan with unique advanced cell technology. It is equipped with 24000mAh rechargeable batteries for 11-60 hrs super-long endurance. You can also use it for your phone, tablet, or laptop in an emergency.

【4 Speeds Powerful & Energy-efficient】This camping fan features a premium motor and ultra-thin fan blade to improve wind power while minimizing noise (＜30 dB). It has a faster speed (3950 r/min) and stronger wind (5.2 m/s), which provide you with super airflow and keep the air circulation in the tent, and will not disturb your sleep or do anything.

【Adjustability / Versatility & Customize Comfort】3 timers give you the option to turn off the battery fan during a break; 2 levels of LED light give your eyes care in the darkness; Easy remote control when you have a distance to the fan; Vertically adjustable fan head to choose the optimal cool breeze you want; Hidden hook at the bottom for easy hanging from the top.

【Super Reliable & Stable】The outdoor fan is made from ABS material with sturdy and anti-drop design, you can take it anywhere you want to go on your adventures. The fan also equipped with non-slip pads on the bottom, which makes it more stable on the desktop.

【Embrace Outdoor Comfort】 Stay cool and serene while conserving energy. Whether hiking, fishing, picnics, beaches, or hot sporting events, our multi-functional outdoor fan is the great camping essential accessory for a refreshing and comfortable experience in nature.
